title: Jed York, 49ers' brass are making plans in advance of potential suspension

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jed York, 49ers' brass are making plans in advance of potential suspension
sources.description: With 49ers owner Jed York facing a potential suspension as a result of his recent no-contest plea on charges arising from a recent prostitution arrest in Ohio, the powers-that-be are making plans now in the event York isn't available later.
